file: 412 Hatsune Miku Waited 4 Years to Play Coachella.mp4

lines.t: Hatsune Miku had to wait four years to play Coachella.

full.credit: Clips: Wilson (fan recording, Coachella 2024); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)

lines.t: She was booked for Coachella 2020. Then the pandemic cancelled the whole festival.

full.credit: Clips: Wilson (fan recording, Coachella 2024); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)

lines.t: She finally played it in April 2024. But fans were shocked.

full.credit: Clips: Wilson (fan recording, Coachella 2024); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)

lines.t: Instead of a hologram, she showed up on a giant LED screen. And some fans were not happy.

full.credit: Clips: Wilson (fan recording, Coachella 2024); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)

lines.t: Hologram or screen, does it matter?

full.credit: Clips: Wilson (fan recording, Coachella 2024); Hatsune Miku official (YouTube)
